title: The same intellectual work.
paragraphs: YIN Renlong starts with a controlled comparison. A friend and an AI supply equivalent assistance, and the writer undertakes the same work of examining sources and developing an argument. The unresolved question concerns what would justify judging those processes differently.

The distinction between a good argument and its author’s understanding motivates the inquiry. Technical explanations of how a model generates a response can inform educational judgment. They still leave the learner’s activity to be examined.

left.title: A friend
left.text: A friend offers a distinction. The writer examines the sources and develops the argument.

right.title: An AI system
right.text: An AI offers equivalent assistance. The writer examines the sources and develops the argument.

quote.text: An AI system offers the same kind of assistance, and I undertake the same intellectual work.

title: A change of case.
paragraphs: The assistant consults guidance that encourages feedback from supervisors and friends. A qualification follows. Allowing a friend to offer advice does not authorise that friend to devise the entire proposal.

YIN Renlong accepts the caution and questions its relevance. Substituting complete proposal production for equivalent advice changes the amount and function of assistance. The reply has introduced a different case.

left.title: Giving feedback
left.text: The writer receives a suggestion and develops the proposal.

right.title: Devising the whole proposal
right.text: The substituted example changes what the adviser supplies. The writer’s remaining activity is unspecified.

quote.text: Encouraging human feedback does not amount to authorising a friend to devise an entire proposal on the applicant's behalf.

title: Back to the question.
paragraphs: The preserved exchange makes the recurrence precise. At the start of M60, the assistant acknowledges that its earlier answer did not address the comparison directly enough. Later in that same response, it reintroduces a qualification about human feedback. In M61, YIN Renlong quotes that qualification and asks again whether AI can provide the same assistance.

M62 then states that feedback can itself generate ideas. The published article gathers these moves into its account of the recurring objection. The sequence establishes what was expressed; whether it demonstrates a more adequate understanding depends on how those contributions are interpreted.

left.title: Acknowledgment
left.text: The assistant accepts that equivalent assistance needs a further justification for different treatment.

right.title: The objection returns
right.text: When the qualification resurfaces, YIN Renlong restores the comparison of equivalent feedback.

quote.text: Yet the qualification about human feedback and AI-generated arguments resurfaced, and I again objected that AI could supply the same kind of feedback.

title: What becomes my own?
paragraphs: In M58, the assistant distinguishes originating an idea from understanding and developing it. The published article later describes accepting that distinction while continuing to question unequal treatment of equivalent assistance. The original response and the later account of accepting it provide different kinds of evidence.

The separate claims require separate evidence. Writing every sentence, feeling ownership of the result and being able to justify its reasoning can diverge. The article’s later discussion of authorship research makes that divergence more concrete.

left.title: Origination
left.text: Who first supplied the idea, and what did each participant contribute to its development?

right.title: Understanding
right.text: What can the learner explain and defend after working with the idea?

quote.text: The phrase “my own thinking” can refer to several different achievements.

title: A question can introduce an idea.
paragraphs: The assistant supplies a hypothetical question about methodological and metaphysical naturalism. Investigating that distinction could change the premises of a theological argument. Feedback could thereby help generate the idea around which the argument develops.

The article later proposes examining the inference itself. A restriction within scientific method does not by itself establish a claim about everything that exists. Challenging that metaphysical step can preserve the scientific finding. These are teaching contrasts proposed in the essay.

left.title: Within scientific method
left.text: A method restricts the explanations it admits for a particular investigation.

right.title: About everything that exists
right.text: Moving to an exhaustive metaphysical claim requires a further argument.

quote.text: Does your argument distinguish methodological naturalism from metaphysical naturalism?

title: What does the intermediary add?
paragraphs: YIN Renlong imagines a friend passing on an AI suggestion unchanged. If the writer develops it in the same way, routing the suggestion through a person does not itself improve the argument or increase the writer’s contribution.

Evaluation or contextualisation by the friend would add intellectual work. Later reading also complicates counts of interventions. Accepting a sound suggestion can require judgment, while a correction can introduce an error.

left.title: An unchanged relay
left.text: The suggestion passes through a friend while its content and the learner’s subsequent work stay constant.

right.title: A substantive contribution
right.text: The friend checks, corrects or contextualises the suggestion before passing it on.

quote.text: An unchanged relay does not add that work.

title: How much must I understand directly?
paragraphs: YIN Renlong’s reading of Hardwig qualifies the emerging requirement to explain and defend everything. Scholarship often relies on specialist knowledge that one person cannot reproduce. That makes the grounds for reliance part of the inquiry.

A Science and Religion student might rely on specialist physics while scrutinising a theological inference. Whether that reliance meets an assessment’s purpose depends on the capacity being assessed. An account of responsible dependence must identify that capacity.

left.title: Reliance on expertise
left.text: What grounds justify accepting a specialist claim that I cannot fully reproduce?

right.title: The task being assessed
right.text: Which inference or interpretive judgment must I demonstrate myself?

quote.text: This qualifies my emerging emphasis on being able to explain and defend everything.

title: The writer returns as a reader.
paragraphs: YIN Renlong describes developing a blog post through AI conversation and returning to study it later. The return raises a temporal question. What becomes understandable during this later encounter, and how could that development be demonstrated?

His reading of ICAP challenges a simple inference from conversation to learning. Alternating messages alone does not establish constructive engagement. The archive records expressed exchanges while leaving some reading and reflection outside its view.

The current edition preserves this published account of returning. A separately dated explanation produced during the later research has not yet been added to the evidence. Such a return would extend the record as a new episode.

left.title: During composition
left.text: A person helps develop a text whose ideas they may understand only partly.

right.title: During the return
right.text: The same person studies the preserved text and may develop further understanding.

quote.text: Can a text that I helped produce become material from which I subsequently learn?

title: The literature changes the questions.
kicker: A later stage of the inquiry
paragraphs: The essay explicitly places its literature review after the original exchange. Feedback literacy directs attention to what a learner does with a comment. Studies in mathematics and physics further distinguish assisted performance from learning demonstrated under particular conditions.

Their results concern different educational arrangements. The article also examines policy research and Value Sensitive Design to question how evidence is collected and interpreted. Transfer into theological education remains a task for disciplinary investigation.

left.title: Assisted performance
left.text: How well does a learner complete the task while the particular form of help is available?

right.title: Subsequent capacity
right.text: What can the learner explain or apply later, and under which conditions?

quote.text: The further reading incorporated here belongs to a later stage of that inquiry.

title: What does the record establish?
kicker: From visible work to educational judgment
paragraphs: The article uses assessment scholarship to examine the inference from a written product to its author’s capacities. Quality of prose, present understanding and independent origination each require an appropriate account of the evidence.

A complete interaction record would still need interpretation. Rejection may express understanding or a mistake. Acceptance may follow careful evaluation or simple reassurance. Computational organisation can expose the relevant passages and assumptions while leaving these judgments open to examination.

left.title: What is observable
left.text: A passage, an intervention or a later explanation can be preserved for inspection.

right.title: What is inferred
right.text: Claims about understanding and responsibility need reasons connecting the record to the educational purpose.

quote.text: We would still have to interpret what those alterations demonstrated.

title: An open question, more precisely asked.
paragraphs: YIN Renlong ends by keeping the comparison open. The model’s agreement does not independently confirm the criticism. The reasons and supporting evidence still need to bear the argument, including any relevant difference the comparison may have overlooked.

The temporal distinction has become sharper. Learning from an assisted text, demonstrating a capacity now and claiming credit for an earlier idea may become warranted at different times. An enduring conclusion can therefore accompany substantial development in its justification.

left.title: The earlier contribution
left.text: The history records which suggestions and interventions helped form the argument.

right.title: Understanding now
right.text: A later explanation supplies evidence about the capacity demonstrated at that later moment.

quote.text: Later understanding does not erase earlier assistance; earlier assistance does not settle what I can subsequently learn.

research_note.title: Responsibility within theological scholarship
research_note.text: The article places the authorship question within theology’s dependence on received texts and arguments. The research asks how the writer becomes able to interpret and take responsibility for those contributions. Examining the grounds for a judgment gives the preserved exchanges their pedagogical significance.
